newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Australian deputy PM to visit Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Australian deputy PM to visit Pakistan.

text.p: Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Trade Minister Tim Fischer will visit Pakistan next month to promote trade, an Australian diplomat said on Tuesday.
Fischer, accompanied by a 15-member business delegation, will hold trade seminars in Karachi and Islamabad and meet Pakistani government leaders during his April 2-6 trip.
"The focus will be very much on business and trade," the diplomat said.
Pakistani exports to Australia totaled $111.6 million in fiscal 1995/96 (July-June) against imports of $248.9 million, according to the Federal Bureau of Statistics.
Fischer also hopes to visit the rugged Khyber Pass on the Afghan border, a smuggling route for much of the opium and hashish produced in Afghanistan, the diplomat said.
Fischer will fly to Bangladesh on April 6.
